usedFor: HubSpot holds products and tickets, and Ticket Tailor receives them as products and ticket types through “Create a Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Created” in HubSpot, then “Create a Product” in Ticket Tailor
bestTemplate.why: A product added in HubSpot appears in Ticket Tailor too, so you list it once.

watchOut: “Create a Ticket Type” needs an event series ID, so supply it when mapping “Ticket Created or Updated”.
